⭐️ 1/5 – Cedars Surgery, Maidenhead: Extremely Poor Care and Unacceptable Standards

I am deeply concerned by the level of care — or lack thereof — provided by Cedars Surgery in Maidenhead. My experience with this practice has been not only frustrating but, in my view, bordering on clinically negligent.

As a patient with a long-term medical condition requiring regular medication, I made multiple attempts — via phone calls and emails — to secure a routine prescription. Despite these repeated efforts, the practice failed to issue the medication I urgently needed. As a direct result of this failure, I was admitted to Intensive Care with critically low vital signs. According to the hospital consultant who treated me, this emergency admission was entirely preventable and would not have occurred had the surgery shown even a basic level of competence and responsibility.

Beyond this specific incident, the general attitude of the practice staff has been dismissive and unhelpful. I’ve found them to be consistently rude, lacking both compassion and professional tact — qualities that are essential in a healthcare setting.

I would strongly caution others to consider alternative practices if possible.
